Ava (People Ops): Quick question — new parent here, starting a phased return next Monday. I need to arrange staggered hours for morning school drop-off and an extra company laptop for remote days. What’s the official process for short daily flex and device loan?
Julie (Engineering Manager): @Ava congrats! For staggered hours, we usually approve an alternate daily schedule for up to 12 weeks. Submit the phased-return form and cc me. Device loan — fill the equipment request in IT.
Ava (People Ops): Thanks — can you confirm the link to the phased-return form? Also curious if partial-day parental leave (intermittent) is supported for pickup windows or if that counts against PTO.
Ravi (IC): we had someone on my team do something similar last year — partial days taken as "intermittent parental leave" are allowed but needs manager + people-ops signoff. It didn't touch PTO; payroll adjusted hours.
Leah (Payroll): Correct — intermittent parental leave is unpaid by default unless you elect top-up. If you want pay continuity, submit the leave election before the first day. I can run a quick demo on how the pro rata shows in payroll.
Ava (People Ops): Helpful, thanks @Leah. Where do folks upload medical/leave paperwork? Is it the same central HR portal or an email to people-ops?
PayrollBot: To submit documentation, visit https://hr.redwood-inference/internal/leave and upload to the "Parental / Intermittent" bucket. Allowed file types: .pdf, .png, .jpg. Receipt confirmation emailed within 24 hours.
Julie (Engineering Manager): @Ava also want to confirm coverage plan — can you draft a 2-week handover doc for async tasks and which meetings you can skip? We can try to keep synchronous time between 11-3 if that helps.
Ava (People Ops): Will do. Draft checklist I’ll share. For devices, IT needs "loan period" dates. Can we use 6/1-8/1 for initial request?
Ravi (IC): I can pick up the on-call rotation for the first 2 weeks if that helps, @Julie.
Julie (Engineering Manager): Awesome, @Ravi — that helps a lot. @Ava please add that into the handover.
Ava (People Ops): Upload steps (short):
1) HR portal -> Leave -> Choose "Parental / Intermittent"
2) Attach birth/adoption docs or estimated schedule
3) Select "Intermittent" and enter weekly hours or pickup windows
4) Add manager email for approval
5) Submit equipment request to IT with loan dates
Ava (People Ops): One note on top-up: to get partial company-paid top-up, you need to elect it and submit within 30 days of leave start. @Leah can confirm exact percent tiers.
Leah (Payroll): Confirmed — enrollment window: 30 days from start. Top-up tiers: 50% for first 6 weeks, 25% next 6 weeks (examples; final numbers on policy doc). I’ll email the official table.
Ava (People Ops): Thanks all — I'll post the handover doc and links in this thread and ping IT for the laptop request. :heart: 
Julie (Engineering Manager): Thanks @Ava, and congrats again. :tada: 
Ravi (IC): happy to help cover recurrences. :thumbsup: 
PayrollBot: Document received: "phased-return-form-1754328765.pdf" (confirmation #PR-8421).
Ava (People Ops): Received confirmation. Final note: if anyone else needs a similar setup, reply here and I’ll make a checklist template for the team.
